subject.title: refactor: move non-session runtime journals to SQLite

question: Should the shipped `streamLogPath` response contract remain available through a SQLite-backed/export compatibility projection, or may this PR intentionally remove it as a breaking API change?
rationale: Repository policy favors one canonical SQLite store, but v2026.7.1 explicitly promises a tail-able diagnostic path; choosing the compatibility period and permanent replacement is a product/API decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Preserve and deprecate
options.body: Keep `streamLogPath` working through a bounded SQLite-backed diagnostic projection or equivalent compatible handle, document the replacement, and remove it only after a stated deprecation window.

options.title: Approve breaking removal
options.body: Explicitly accept the operator/API break, document downstream migration and release scope, and provide a supported command or API for retrieving the stored relay history.

recommendation.title: Preserve and deprecate
recommendation.body: Keep `streamLogPath` working through a bounded SQLite-backed diagnostic projection or equivalent compatible handle, document the replacement, and remove it only after a stated deprecation window.
